race.comment: SHEZA ALIBI (16) dominant winner of the G1 Maybe Diva two back, then stepped out to the 2000m in a brutally run race with a gallant head second in the G1 Might And Power Stakes at Caulfield. Versatile mare back to her right trip and look for her launching late. AUTUMN BOY (3) raced without luck all prep and looks one of the few genuine chances. Held up in traffic back in the field and never got a clear crack at them when seventh as fav over 1600m at this track in the G1 Epsom. Can race closer from the draw and return to form. SKYHOOK (2) has gone to a new level this campaign and is desperate for the trip. Sat on a fast tempo in the LR Silver Eagle over 1300m at this track when collared late to run second. Will ping from the wide gate and prove hard to stop. BEIWACHT (1) multiple Group 1 winner with the three 1400m wins on his CV. Likely leader expected to take a hand in the finish. APOCALYPTIC (17) went to a new level winning the LR Silver Eagle. Mile winner worth thought.
